_readme: nCAD aesthetic STYLE presets. A style is a bundle of geometry-biasing rules the DETERMINISTIC stack applies on top of whatever the engine produces. The LLM picks a style ONCE at the confirm gate (overridable); it is stored on the recipe as job.config.style so a revision can restyle with NO LLM call. Every field applies where it can and is ignored where it can't (a stack-only style forced onto the structural engine still colors + biases what it's able to). Edit hexes/ranges freely — this file is inert data.

form.label: form
form.doc: 0 = tangent/organic rounds, 1 = planar facets & sharp arrises

mass.label: mass
mass.doc: 0 = solid closed walls, 1 = grown/cellular open load-paths

spine_doc: Bones (raw grown) → Evolved Elegance (refined grown) → Gothic (grown structure re-expressed as ornament). Highlight this arc in the picker.

field_doc.engine_affinity: structural | stack | either — nudges the gate's auto engine choice (does not force it).
field_doc.edge.fillet_policy: none | tool-radius | uniform | tangent-blend | g2 — increasing roundness/continuity.
field_doc.edge.chamfer_policy: none | edge-break | top-edges | facet | fine-arris | overhang-45.
field_doc.edge.corner_radius_mm: the ONE reused radius for the 'uniform' policy (null otherwise).
field_doc.edge.chamfer_mm: chamfer size when chamfer_policy applies (null otherwise).
field_doc.structural.volfrac: [lo,hi] target material fraction; the stack clamps the working volfrac into this band (recipe still overrides).
field_doc.structural.quality_pref: draft | balanced | fine | null — pre-selects the Quality knob at the gate (user can change).
field_doc.structural.symmetry: none | mirror | axial | mirror-axial — enforced by averaging the density field each iteration.
field_doc.structural.mesh_finish: faceted | as-is | smooth | g2-polish — post-process on the marching-cubes mesh (the 'fillet policy' for the organic engine).
field_doc.feature_language: ribs | flutes | pockets | lattice | tracery | taper | facets — additive/subtractive geometry ops (deepest slice).
field_doc.finish: implied real-world finish (label + tone hint; no geometry).

soft-industrial.label: Soft Industrial
soft-industrial.blurb: Rams/Braun restraint — one radius, hidden fasteners.

cnc-billet.label: CNC Billet
cnc-billet.blurb: Carved from a solid block — pockets + countersinks.

faceted-crystalline.label: Faceted / Crystalline
faceted-crystalline.blurb: Gem-cut — chamfers not fillets, sharp arrises.

lattice-gyroid.label: Lattice / Gyroid
lattice-gyroid.blurb: Cellular, printed-light — solid skin + gyroid infill.

maker-honest.label: Maker-Honest
maker-honest.blurb: Designed for the nozzle — support-free, exposed ribs.

retro-futurist.label: Retro-Futurist
retro-futurist.blurb: Pill forms, big soft radii, continuous surfaces.

monolith-slab.label: Monolith / Slab
monolith-slab.blurb: Heavy, minimal, quiet mass — one tiny chamfer.

aero-streamlined.label: Aero / Streamlined
aero-streamlined.blurb: Teardrop, tapered, fluid — no abrupt steps.

gothic.label: Gothic
gothic.blurb: Structural ornament — pointed arches, ribs, verticality.

evolved-elegance.label: Evolved Elegance
evolved-elegance.blurb: The refined biomimetic — few clean members, jewelry-grade.
